title: TEST-011: serial_open_reports_not_a_serial_port expects ENOTTY from /dev/null, macOS 27 returns ENODEV, so make test-unit fails and skips the remaining unit suites
description:
indigo_test/unit/test_uni_io.c:97 asserts the message 'Not a serial port', which needs the OS to fail TIOCEXCL or tcsetattr on /dev/null with ENOTTY. On macOS 27 both fail with ENODEV, which indigo_uni_io.c correctly maps to 'Serial device is not connected'. The test-unit loop exits on the first failing suite, so every run on this host fails and the RAW image suite never runs. Next action: make the expectation platform-independent (for example a regular file or a pty pair where ENOTTY is guaranteed, or accept the documented ENODEV mapping), without weakening the error-message contract.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-000047.json (category: quality, blocking: no).
